frequency_question: How often do such states successfully stand up an operational domestic production line for high-tech missiles within a multi-year window?
membership_rule: Includes any wartime transfer of complex guided missile technology where the recipient nation attempted to establish native assembly or manufacturing. Excludes basic munitions, unguided rockets, or peacetime licensing.
window: 1940 to present, restricted to high-intensity state-on-state conflicts.

cases.name: Nazi Germany V-weapon transfer attempts to occupied/satellite sites
Taiwan Hsiung Feng missile domestic production initiation
Pakistan Babur cruise missile domestic manufacturing establishment

coverage_note: 3 named; limited sample of comparable advanced cruise missile localization under extreme duress.
known_gaps: Extremely sparse historical data for contemporary cruise missile technology sharing and rapid wartime localization.
skeleton: 3 historical episodes of complex foreign missile domestic production attempts during high friction or war, yielding 2 successful domestic lines.
validity_reason: Based on long-term technological transfer dynamics and industrial mobilization constraints which evolve slowly over decades.
